svg.text: Printable parts (millimetres). Print the raft coupons in Formlabs Grey V5 resin (wash, post-cure); the rests in PLA.
1. Raft coupon (raft_coupon.stl), one per trial, 27 g
plan: 50 x 60 outside; dashed: 44 x 54 bottom face
side: 8 thick; bottom 3 mm bevelled 45 deg all round
printed flat, chamfer down; one coupon per trial
2. Scraper rests (rest_plastic_scraper.stl, rib 128 long; rest_metal_scraper.stl, rib 160 long)
rib 10 x 10 at 45 deg; its top face carries the scraper's underside
the scraper's edge sits 10 mm above the bench, 1.5 mm behind a 6 x 64 x 14 lip
two 10 x 10 posts at 25 % and 80 % of the rib; tape or screw the rest down
rests stand 115 mm apart; scraper edges 30 mm in front of the printer's front face

3. Placing template (placing_template.stl, 2 mm PLA frame 80 x 110 with a 52 x 62 window): push it into the well's back-left corner; the window is 11 mm from the back wall, its centre 65 mm from the left wall.
